text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. From now on, every time I look
at these
plushies, I'll remember today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Would you mind holding on to some of
them,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That way, you won't ever forget today
either.
